summary: South Cotabato 2nd District representative with 72 principal-authored bills. Authored a VAT exemption for mental health drugs, National Internal Revenue Code amendments and presidential authority to suspend fuel taxes. Co-authored a daily wage increase for workers.
caveat: Direction of the NIRC amendments was not reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a VAT exemption for mental health drugs (-1) and presidential authority to suspend fuel taxes (+1) as one taxes issue, and co-authored a daily wage increase (-2).
